correctness.rationale: The graph is explicitly fixed by its LCF edges. Two independent cycle tests agree on every one of its 2^18 induced vertex subsets, yielding 204492 faces. A coordinate-toggle Morse matching is exhaustively checked acyclic on all 1704456 Hasse incidences, leaving one 0-cell, one 9-cell, 62 10-cells and 21 11-cells. The exact signed Morse boundaries are chain-compatible: d10 has a coefficient ±1 and is surjective, and d11 admits a literal sequence of 21 unimodular pivots with zero residual. Thus reduced integral H10 is Z^40, no torsion. The Morse CW model is 8-connected and H9 vanishes, hence it is 9-connected by Hurewicz. Choosing 40 Hurewicz representatives yields a homology equivalence from a 40-fold wedge of S10; simply connected homological Whitehead makes this a homotopy equivalence. All 216 automorphisms are exhaustively generated by distance-preserving bijections; signed fixed-face Lefschetz sums give the complete rational character, whose total is 216 and sum of squares 2160. The included executable is the exact reproducibility evidence; computation does not claim an infinite family theorem.

originality.rationale: Original source full-text comparisons distinguish the induced vertex-forest simplicial complex from edge-matching, independent-set, Rips and Cech complexes on the Pappus graph. Taylan develops general devoid-complex methods, Zuffi defines the vertex-induced acyclic complex, and Carnero Bravo develops the forest filtration on several graph families; none of the material read states a Pappus forest homotopy or rational automorphism-character calculation. Actual indexed-result searches identify superficially similar Pappus results, whose domains do not imply the proposed combined statement. Unindexed literature and inaccessible full texts retain residual risk, so no absolute priority is asserted.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical highly symmetric eighteen-vertex incidence geometry. Acyclic induced vertex sets directly encode feedback vertex sets and belong to the established forest-filtration construction. Its exact integral sphere-wedge classification in dimension 10 is a natural complete finite topological invariant, and the 216-element top homology character identifies a one-dimensional invariant rational line and an inner product of 10, not inferable from Betti rank. This is a substantive exact structural benchmark, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice or mere known-table recomputation.
